items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: That's where Eddie come here in 18 when Sam Langford and Harry Wills.

ctx.x: You mentioned National Park. That was over on this side. Where was that about, National Park?

Third and Claiborne. Claiborne and what? Right where that school is. Third and Willow, third and Claiborne. They had baseball games there? Baseball games. They had pride fighting. That's where Eddie come here in 18 when Sam Langford and Harry Wills. You was there.

Well, I played. Eddie was playing. Eddie played the trampoline. We had our band played in there. Eddie played the saxophone. That's right. He played that at night. Sam Langford. Then he left. Then he left on out of here. Yes, that's what it is. I played that at night.
